name: local_read_file
description: Read the contents of any file on the local machine

name: local_write_file
description: Write or overwrite a file on the local machine

name: local_append_file
description: Append content to an existing file on the local machine

name: local_delete_file
description: Delete a file from the local machine

name: local_list_directory
description: List files and folders in a directory on the local machine

name: local_create_directory
description: Create a directory or nested directories on the local machine

name: local_run_command
description: Run a shell command on the local machine. Use for npm, git, prisma, build scripts, etc.

name: local_run_script
description: Run a Node.js or shell script file on the local machine

name: local_git_status
description: Get the git status of a local repository — shows changed, staged, and untracked files

name: local_git_log
description: Get the recent git commit history for a local repository

name: local_get_env
description: Read a specific key from the local .env file

name: local_set_env
description: Set or update a key in the local .env file

name: local_search_files
description: Search for files matching a pattern or containing specific text on the local machine
